product.name: Stage Right by Monoprice Studio Monitor Speaker Isolation Pads (pair)
product.description: Acoustic treatment can be costly and intimidating, often leading to making rooms more "dead" without creating a good mixing environment. Studio monitor isolation pads are a different story. They will provide an improvement to your monitoring, regardless of room or acoustic characteristics. Stage Right™ studio monitor isolation pads are the safest, easiest, and most affordable way to improve the sonic accuracy of your monitors.Stage Right™ studio monitor isolation pads are made of high-density foam, which provides the ideal amount of separation between your monitors and the desk or stands. They measure 11.4" x 7.5" and are able to support most common studio monitors (with up to 8" woofer). Their two-piece construction provides additional flexibility, with 3 different monitor angles for placement on stands of different heights.Features: Made of high-density foamMeasures 11.4" x 7.5" x 2.0"Supports 0°, 5°, and 10° monitor anglesStage Right™ and the Stage Right logo are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
